mission.title: Party Crash
mission.description: Plant a bug to overhear a meeting between the commandos and the Merovingian's Exiles.

npc.say: Careful with that thing, it's delicate.

They're probably meeting at the alternate location.
What, Anome didn't tell you about that?
You know who else we haven't spotted lately? Those masked redpills. I wonder where they went off to. Is it just coincidence that they disappeared shortly before the commandos arrived in the City?
We're still monitoring the landing sites you discovered recently. Those black helicopters come and go much more frequently than we'd thought.
This place doesn't look like much, but that's because we need to keep a low profile--and to be able to relocate at a moment's notice.

As sort of a side project, I'm working on implanting surveillance cameras in pigeons. I think it's got a lot of potential, but so far I just have a lot of jerky footage of sidewalks--and other pigeons.
Data analysis isn't the most glamorous job in Zion, but it's the only way to find out most of what goes on in the City.

phase.briefing:
So, there's a new group in the Matrix, is there? Trying to horn in on our territory, no doubt. Good thing you recovered that list of their landing points. In fact, intel thinks that the these so-called commandos have arranged a meeting with the Frenchman's cronies near one of those points. That's where you come in.
First, you're gonna meet Cebriones and get a bug.

enter.say:
Sounds like Anome has his cloak and dagger on today.
Cebriones's in there with the bug.

talk.say: You're Anome's runner? Okay, I've got the bug for you.

done.say: Here, I've got that bug you'll need.

phase.briefing:
You're going to plant that lovely little bug in a certain file cabinet, where it will pick up every word spoken by the commandos and those pestiferous Merovingian lickspittles in their upcoming meeting.
The meeting isn't supposed to happen for a little while yet, so I don't think you need to worry about running into any hostiles.

enter.say: I'm not scanning any active alarm systems in there, but that doesn't mean they don't have some passive ones. I'm not sure I share Anome's confidence. I'll ping you when you're close to that file cabinet.
The file cabinet is in that room.

objective.text: Put the bug in the file cabinet

done.say: I hate to say "I told you so," but I'm picking up building security programs heading in your direction. Betcha there was a silent alarm in there. You might want to make yourself scarce.

phase.briefing:
Building security? Bah. Nothing to worry about. Those programs hardly have sufficient logic loops to dress themselves, let alone find that bug you planted.
Head over to our monitoring station and contact Ruchbah, our local surveillance chief. She should be receiving data from the bug by the time you get there.

enter.say: That's the monitoring station. Ruchbah should be in there.

talk.say: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you, operative: the bug is transmitting, but no meeting is taking place at that location. It's possible that the security alert there earlier frightened them off.

done.say: Uh-oh. This is what Anome gets for taking their building security lightly. I guess we'd better go see what he thinks of this.

phase.briefing:
What? They moved the meeting? How could... Where... Hell! Hang on a sec. ...
Okay, okay. Intel had an alternate address where they thought the meeting had a lesser chance of taking place. I'm sending you there now. It's probably underway already, so just get there and...learn what you can. If the commandos or the Merovingian's peons cause trouble, eviscerate them!

enter.say: I'm reading multiple commando and Merovingian signals in there. That's where the meeting's going down, all right. What's Anome got us into now?
Head's up. Looks like there's a welcoming committee.
They're trying to help the Merovingian! The stinking turd lump who killed Morpheus! Destroy the Merovingians, now!

done.say: I'm scanning more Exiles in nearby rooms. We'd better get them all.

complete.say: ... Cease hostilities and pull out of the mission area immediately, operative. This is... That is a direct order from Commander Lock. I repeat: cease fire and leave the area immediately.

mission.finish:
I apologize for the abrupt termination of the mission, soldier. The decision was...out of my hands. Commander Lock has decided that we should...bear the olive branch when dealing with the commandos. Even if they're trying to assist our enemies!
I--no, never mind. Tyndall will be your controller on the next mission. That is all.
